subject: Follow-up: Atlas Payments POC success criteria & next steps
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Samir Gupta <samir@atlaspayments.com>, Elena Ortiz <elena.ortiz@atlaspayments.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-02T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Follow-up: POC success criteria & next steps

Hi Samir / Elena —

Thanks for the time today. Quick recap and proposed success criteria for the POC/trial so we can align expectations:

POC objective:
- Validate Redwood inference for Atlas Payments' transaction classification and summarization workloads under production-like load.

Proposed success criteria / KPIs:
- Latency: P95 <= 200ms (in-region) for 1k-token average request
- Throughput: sustained 150 req/s baseline with ability to burst to 250 req/s for short periods
- Cost: target <= $0.0015 / token (platform + infra blended) at trial volumes; Redwood to provide cost model
- Quality: 90% pass rate on the agreed labeled sample set (precision/recall thresholds in attached eval plan)
- Availability: >= 99.5% during the trial window

Evaluation plan:
- Atlas provides a representative dataset (1000 labeled samples + live traffic replay) and expected labels by Sept 5
- Redwood will deploy a dedicated trial environment (rw-large-v2-quant) with instrumentation and dashboards
- Load testing: synthetic ramp to peak throughput; collect P95/P99 latency, error rates, token counts
- Quality validation: run labeled sample set and metric comparison; SLOs measured daily

Ownership & timeline:
- Atlas owner: Samir (dataset + traffic replay, access to test accounts) — delivery by Sept 5
- Redwood owner: Jordan (trial environment, dashboards), Marissa (cluster provisioning) — provisioning by Sept 6
- Security/compliance: Rishi to coordinate the questionnaire and provide SOC2 artifacts

Proposed timeline:
- Sept 2: confirm dataset and POC owner
- Sept 6: trial environment live
- Sept 13: midpoint check-in (metrics & interim findings)
- Sept 20: end of trial; final review week of Sept 20–24

Next steps:
- Samir: confirm datasets and any sampling constraints
- Atlas: share access details for traffic replay (S3 link or replay endpoint)
- Jordan/Marissa/Rishi: we'll send the POC MAP and SOW draft (attached)

Attachments: POC-MAP-v1.xlsx, atlas_security_questionnaire.pdf

Best,
Jordan Blake
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: Samir Gupta <samir@atlaspayments.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Ortiz <elena.ortiz@atlaspayments.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-02T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: POC success criteria & next steps

Thanks Jordan — really useful summary.

A couple of clarifications / constraints on our side:
- Dataset: we can deliver the labeled sample set (1k) by EOD Sept 4 and the traffic replay S3 link by Sept 5
- Throughput: initial expectation is closer to 150 req/s sustained; we do need the ability to burst to 250 req/s for short windows (e.g., batch settlement). Can we model both steady-state and burst behavior in the trial?
- Cost: can you provide a simple expected cost range for a 2-week run (we'll be roughly 2–3M tokens total)? A line-item estimate will help our procurement team.
- Security: we'll send the partially completed questionnaire today; expect more follow-up from our security team (CC: Elena).

If those align, we confirm Sept 6 start for provisioning. Also, please share the SOW link when ready.

Best,
Samir
Head of Payments Engineering
Atlas Payments
